options.aurorion_talk.preview.long: A long speech bubble for test purposes, to check the line wrap
options.aurorion_talk.hidePlayerChat.too: Player messages leave the chat HUD and become balloons only. System messages, command output, deaths and join/leave still show up.
options.aurorion_talk.hideOnlyWhenBalloo: Keeps messages in chat when the sender is too far away to render a balloon, so nothing is lost.
options.aurorion_talk.showOwnBalloon.too: Also create a balloon above your own character. Visible in third person.
screen.aurorion_talk.low_contrast: Low contrast — the text will be lightened or darkened so it stays readable.
